# youtrack_project (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing YouTrack project by its short name (the issue ID prefix, such as `DEMO`), for instance to reference a project that is not managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a project that already exists in YouTrack and is not managed by Terraform.
data "youtrack_project" "support" {
  short_name = "SUP"
}

output "support_project_id" {
  value = data.youtrack_project.support.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `short_name` (String) Short name of the project, the prefix of its issue IDs.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the project is archived.
- `description` (String) Description of the project.
- `id` (String) Entity ID of the project, such as `0-0`.
- `leader_login` (String) Login of the project owner.
- `name` (String) Name of the project.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the project is a template.
